scope: All official split image headers and annotation files; sampled training-only masks

full_scan.image_pixels_fully_decoded: Only sampled overlay images, not the full image corpus

training_mask_sample.sampling: Uniform random without replacement from all readable paired training records; seed fixed
training_mask_sample.method: Valid normalized polygons scaled to original resolution; pycocotools per-class unions; source annotations unchanged

limitations: Unannotated pixels are not independently verified defect-free background.
Polygon geometry checks do not establish annotation completeness or semantic correctness.
Image headers were read; full-corpus decoded-image integrity was not tested.
SHA256 checks exact file duplicates only; re-encoded copies, near-duplicates and related crops are not excluded.
No verified physical structure, capture-session or source-image grouping metadata was supplied by the local layout (groups_csv: null).
Official partitions are inventoried, not proven leakage-free; do not infer structure IDs from filenames.
Sampled raster-mask occupancy describes only the selected training sample, not full-corpus pixel proportions.
No corrosion class is defined by local data.yaml; no model training or performance claims are made.
Zero signed/shoelace area may indicate collinearity or self-intersecting lobes that cancel; it does not imply every flagged polygon rasterizes to zero pixels.

duplicate_summary.interpretation: Cross-split exact-image duplication is confirmed; establish a separate, reviewed duplicate/group-aware internal evaluation protocol before training. Preserve source files and official split records. Check annotation differences before deduplication.
